content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Technical Support-I and Project Technical Support-III positions is 05 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by AIIMS Delhi for the Project Technical Support-I and Project Technical Support-III positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Technical Support I?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support I, candidates need either a Class 10th with a Diploma in MLT and 2 years of experience, or a 3-year Bachelor's Degree in Science with 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support III position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should apply by sending their updated CV and experience certificates via email to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for these project-based roles?
faq.answer: The salary for these positions will be determined as per the guidelines set by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi, located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of these job openings?
faq.answer: These are project-based positions, indicating that they are temporary and tied to the duration of the specific research project.
